test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

It is __the most effective__ means of mass communication.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e. **"No improvement".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence* "It is 'the most effective' means of mass communication." *is already** grammatically correct.**
 
• The phrase **"the most effective"** is a superlative adjective phrase correctly modifying the noun** "means".**
 
• It is comparing the subject to all other possible alternatives and stating that it is at the top of all of them in terms of effectiveness.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *'It is the most effective means of mass communication.'*
